name: Husqvarna PG 8 DR
summary: Remote-controlled planetary floor grinder with an 800 mm grinding width and Dual Drive Technology, for grinding concrete floors; the operator drives and sets it from a joystick remote control with a live display.

germany.statusNote: Listed on Husqvarna Construction's German website with an EU article number and 'Angebot anfordern', dealer search and demo booking. No public price.

sellers.name: Husqvarna Deutschland GmbH, Construction
sellers.note: Bahnhofstr. 50, 89168 Niederstotzingen (contact page). Article no. 970 60 53-03 (3x380-415 V, 15+1.5 kW, EU); quote request, dealer search and demo booking on the product page.

specs.label: Max output power
specs.conditions: as stated by the motor maker; article listing says 15+1.5 kW

specs.label: Power supply
specs.quote: SCHLEIFMASCHINE PG 8 DR | 3x380-415 V | 15+1.5 kW | EU

specs.label: Remote control
specs.value: joystick remote with anti-glare screen showing power use, input current and motor speed
specs.quote: Der große entspiegelte Bildschirm liefert Echtzeitinformationen wie Stromverbrauch, Eingangsstrom und Motordrehzahl.

specs.label: Grinding head service interval
specs.quote: Abgeschotteter Schleifkopf mit einem Wartungsintervall von 1000 h.

specs.label: Oscillation function
specs.conditions: mimics manual grinding movement for flatter floors in a single pass

notes: Remote-controlled, not autonomous: the operator drives the machine with a joystick remote control (like the Scanmaskin and Schwamborn RC grinders).
Mains-powered for grinding (3-phase); built-in batteries and charger power transport moves on and to the site; fold-out transport wheel.
Mist Cooler water-mist system, adjustable built-in weights for grinding pressure, floating steel shroud for dust pick-up; Husqvarna Fleet Services ready.
